stem: Why did Congress pass the Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882?

options.label: A
options.text: To enhance business ownership and expand ethnic communities for Chinese immigrants

options.label: B
options.text: To address concerns over increased competition for jobs and rising Chinese immigration rates

options.label: C
options.text: To force Chinese immigrants into rural internment camps in an effort to maintain national security

options.label: D
options.text: To discourage Chinese immigrants from building self-sufficient communities in cities around the country
